name: session-recap
description: Recap any AI coding session (Claude Code, Codex, dsh, OpenCode) in a side pane or from the command line: its intent, key decisions, what changed, open threads and where to resume.

model.title: Recap model
model.description: Model that writes recaps (e.g. sonnet, or a full model id). Empty: the session's own model. The pane's Model settings override it.

partModel.title: Model for condensing parts
partModel.description: Optional cheaper model for the part-by-part step of long sessions (e.g. haiku). Empty: the session's own model.
